Councilman James Rogers, alongside Councilmen Chris Wharton and Derek Kitchen as co-sponsors, pushed to continue the debate on the police hires and their proposed homeless housing project downtown at 360 W. 300 South. Last week, the council tabled the vote, and the plan for a homeless housing location remains pending.
Councilman Charlie Luke repeatedly pushed for increased funds for services benefiting families and neighborhoods. He advocated for increased investment in youth programs and neighborhood-based services, stating that these are more effective for prevention compared to police.
